topic: automatic on my way texts and day before reminders
hook: This feels illegal to know if you drive a service truck all day.
caption:
On-my-way texts for contractors: comment TRUCK and I'll reply with how it works.

Karen took Thursday morning off for your visit. It's 10:15 and she's at the window wondering if you're coming.

This robot texts her at 6 PM the day before with your 9 to 11 window, then again when you leave the last job. 1 tap in the truck. Nobody's guessing.

Works for HVAC, plumbers, electricians, roofers. Built in n8n, runs 24/7.

On my way texts, automated customer texts, automation for HVAC, plumbers and electricians, n8n automation.

msgs.text: Hi, are you still coming today??

scenes.speaker: neel

scenes.speaker: neel
scenes.vo: So I built a robot that texts them the day before, with your time window.

msgs.text: Reminder: we'll see you tomorrow between 9 and 11 🙂

scenes.speaker: neel
scenes.vo: Then you tap one button when you leave the last job, and it texts on my way.

scenes.speaker: neel
scenes.vo: Your customer knows exactly when you'll show up. Nobody's guessing.

msgs.text: On my way! See you in about 20 minutes 🚚
